name: protection_station_statistics
description: Test 29 (PR12), the police station statistics vector 0x8A70A0B9 ([0] crimes last month, [1] arrests last month, [2] crimes this month, [3] arrests this month). Police, shipped arrest threshold 20; the crime lot 500 at cell (2, 2) reads the adjusted tract (1, 1), nearest station 1 at (40, 40). Property absent, a crime (value 20, unarrested): the vector reads as empty, padded to 4 [choice], [2] += 1 -> [0, 0, 1, 0]. Present [5, 6, 7, 8, 9], an arrest (value 21): [2] += 1 and [3] += 1, the fifth element kept -> [5, 6, 8, 9, 9]; ProcessMonthlyCrimeStats shifts v[1] := v[3], v[0] := v[2], v[3] := 0, v[2] := 0 and writes the whole vector back -> [8, 9, 0, 0, 9]. Present [1, 2] (short), a crime -> padded with zeros to 4 [choice], [1, 2, 1, 0]. Hand-derived from 9.2 and 9.3.
